import sys, time, numpy as np, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import te.engine.qp as QP
counts=[]
orig=QP._active_set
def wrap(*a,**k):
    t=time.time(); r=orig(*a,**k); counts.append((time.time()-t, a[4], len(a[1]), len(a[3])))
    return r
QP._active_set=wrap
from te.engine.qp import solve_qp

def build(ncom, slots_per, mode, caps, demands, B, rho, identical=True, seed=0):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    # build a shared set of paths
    E=len(caps)
    def mkpath():
        # random simple path over live edges
        e=rng.randrange(E)
        return [e]
    psets=[]
    base=[[rng.randrange(E)] for _ in range(slots_per)]
    for k in range(ncom):
        if identical:
            psets.append([list(p) for p in base])
        else:
            psets.append([[rng.randrange(E)] for _ in range(slots_per)])
    paths=psets
    n=sum(len([p for p in ps]) for ps in paths)
    var=[(k,p) for k in range(ncom) for p in range(slots_per)]
    A=np.zeros((E,len(var)))
    for j,(k,p) in enumerate(var):
        A[paths[k][p][0], j] = 1.0/caps[paths[k][p][0]]
    Q=np.eye(len(var))+rho*(A.T@A)
    q=-rho*(A.T@np.array(B))
    if mode=='admit': q=q-1.0
    m=ncom
    C=np.zeros((m,len(var))); d=np.zeros(m)
    for i in range(m):
        for j,(k,p) in enumerate(var):
            if k==i: C[i,j]=1.0
        d[i]=demands
    eq=[mode=='route']*m
    x0=np.zeros(len(var))
    if mode=='route':
        for i in range(m):
            v=d[i]/slots_per
            for j,(k,p) in enumerate(var):
                if k==i: x0[j]=v
    return Q,q,C,d,eq,x0

scenarios=[
    ("sym route cap1", build(24,4,'route',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*24,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route cap1 rho1", build(24,4,'route',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*24,[0.0]*8,1)),
    ("sym admit cap1", build(24,4,'admit',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*24,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route bigB", build(24,4,'route',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*24,[500.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route tinyB", build(24,4,'route',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*24,[-500.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route d1", build(24,4,'route',[1.0]*8,[1.0]*24,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("rand route", build(24,4,'route',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*24,[0.0]*8,8,identical=False)),
    ("rand admit", build(24,4,'admit',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*24,[0.0]*8,8,identical=False,seed=3)),
    ("sym route 8 slots", build(12,8,'route',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*12,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym admit 8 slots", build(12,8,'admit',[1.0]*8,[1000.0]*12,[0.0]*8,8)),
    ("sym route mixed caps", build(24,4,'route',[1.0,2.0,3.0,100.0,1.0,7.0,50.0,9.0],[100.0]*24,[0.0]*8,8)),
]
for name,(Q,q,C,d,eq,x0) in scenarios:
    counts.clear()
    t=time.time()
    x,lam,ok=solve_qp(Q,q,C,d,eq,x0)
    dt=time.time()-t
    # verify
    n=len(q); m=len(d)
    g=Q@x+q; nu=g+C.T@lam
    bad=[]
    if x.min()<-1e-9: bad.append('neg')
    for i in range(n):
        if x[i]<=0 and nu[i]<-1e-7: bad.append('nu%d=%g'%(i,nu[i]))
    for k in range(m):
        if eq[k] and abs(C[k]@x-d[k])>1e-6: bad.append('eq%d'%k)
        if not eq[k]:
            if C[k]@x>d[k]+1e-6: bad.append('in%d'%k)
            if lam[k]<-1e-9: bad.append('lam%d'%k)
    print("%-24s n=%3d m=%2d %.3fs ok=%s iters=%d bad=%s"%(name,n,m,dt,ok,len(counts),bad[:3]))
